status: finite numerical diagnostic of supplied verified candidate; not a proof

candidate.status: user-authorized six-study nine-parameter exploratory candidate freeze
candidate.closure: U_C, U_M, marginal K half-saturation (4 mM) and intact basal paracellular leak adapted from related 19-state C model commit 64ae8344e45dcb45b8b9d2bc9fb0528cd6876aac; not specified in manuscript.

analysis_conditions.distance_norm: maximum absolute state difference divided by the rest-balance state scale; adaptation and trauma scale is one; inventory is included

limitations: Finite output samples and successful solver calls do not prove continuous positivity, physiological bounds, global stability, a basin of attraction or stability under arbitrary forcing.
The local balance fixes the snapshot total-potassium inventory; full-system conservation is conditional on the actual rest boundary flux.
One-sided ATP and gate branch matrices do not prove stability of the nonsmooth switched system.
Single-coordinate perturbations, finite horizons and the chosen scaled infinity norm are limited numerical tests, not validation.
Sampled manuscript ranges are descriptive, not enforced physiological invariants; integration failures can prevent range summaries.
Forced trajectories use matching imposed inputs, not measured pharmacokinetics; the illustrative drug boundary flag remains active throughout.

rest_balance.construction: Solve first nine states within 0.5–1.5 times snapshot values; snapshot inventory fixed, ATP at parameter baseline, gates zero.
